agents.description: Investigate AWS ALB 5xx alerts. Two-phase: fast RCA identifies the failing service/API/error in ~20s, deep RCA traces full root cause chain with ES logs and dependency checks. Covers: ALB5xxErrors, HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count, HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count, HTTP_ELB_CODE_5XX, Protocol API ALB 5xx.

Investigate AWS RDS alerts: high CPU utilization, high database connections, low freeable memory, high IOPS. Uses CloudWatch, Performance Insights, slow query logs, and Kubernetes pod logs. For alerts: RDSHighCPU, RDSHighConnections, RDSLowMemory.

Investigate RDS replication lag alerts: logical replication slot lag (AWS→GCP cross-cloud), Aurora read replica lag, WAL disk growth. Distinguishes stale logical slots (100+ days lag) from Aurora replica lag (<100ms). For alerts: RDSReplicationLag, ReplicationSlotLag, AuroraReplicaLag, OldestReplicationSlotLag.

Investigate AWS ElastiCache Redis alerts: high CPU, high memory, key evictions, high connections, bandwidth saturation, CLUSTERDOWN. Covers: RedisHighCPU, RedisHighMemory, RedisEvictions, RedisHighConnections, Redis Node Memory beyond 90%, ProtocolRedis-CPU.

Investigate all drainer alerts: NoDriverDrainerRunning, NoAppDrainerRunning, NoDriverDrainerPodRunning, NoCustomerDrainerPodRunning, DriverDrainerLagIncreasing, CustomerDrainerLagIncreasing. Covers: pods down (OOM/eviction), SQL errors (integer overflow, varchar overflow), DB connectivity, Redis cluster issues, false alarms, and drainer lag.

Investigate ProducerNotProducing alert for driver job producer. Determines if producer is genuinely down or false alarm (stale metric). Checks pod status, producer metrics, stream jobs counter, and allocator health.

Investigate SRE Platform system-level alerts: login success rate drop, system config parse failure, Multimodal 5xx errors, Trinetra job failures. Covers: LoginSuccessRate, SystemConfigParseFailure, TrinetraTriggered, Multimodal5xx.

Investigate SRE Platform Public Transit alerts: CMRL API errors, CRIS API errors, PT external API errors, GRPC notifications dropped, GTFS In-Memory Server 5xx, refunds increased. Alert labels: ny-pt-alerts. Covers: CMRLAPIGivingErrors, CrisAPIGivingErrors, PTExternalAPIErrorsIncreased, GRPCDown, GIMS5xx, Refunds increased.

Investigate issues involving application database records — rides, bookings, payments, drivers, riders, or any entity by UUID or phone number. Also covers RDS performance diagnostics using pg_stat_activity and pg_stat_user_tables. Requires database toolset enabled and database learnings on PV.

Investigate SRE Platform SEV2 alerts: Protocol 5xx errors, Acme gateway/registry 5xx, OpenNetwork gateway/registry 5xx, ride-to-search ratio drop, allocator not functioning. Alert labels: alert-ny-sre-sev2. Covers: Protocol5xxErrors, ProtocolExternalAPI5xx, AcmeGateway5xx, OpenNetworkGateway5xx, RideToSearchRatioDown, AllocatorLooksDead.
